tax_number.note: Business or tax number for company customers

email.note: Used to match incoming emails to the contact

access_notes.note: Gates, dogs, parking, power and water

site_contact_id.note: On-site contact if different from primary

account_id.note: Set once matched to an existing customer

contact_name.note: Captured before a contact record exists

site_address_text.note: Free text until a site_address is created

lead_id.note: Set when created by converting a lead

current_stage_id.note: Denormalised from stage_instance for fast filtering

quote_number.note: Base number plus version e.g. Q-1042-v2

version.note: Starts at 1. New version supersedes the old

total_value.note: Frozen copy of accepted quote total

hold_reason.note: Required when status is On hold

quote_line_id.note: Traces back to what was quoted

measured_quantity.note: From site measure. Difference can trigger a variation

price_impact.note: Signed. Positive adds to price, negative is a credit

status.note: Approved only when both approvals below are set

project_id.note: At least one of project_id or opportunity_id
At least one of project_id or opportunity_id

stage_id.note: Ties a task to a stage

storage_ref.note: SharePoint item ID or file path

entity_type.note: Table the document is attached to

entity_id.note: Record ID in that table. Validated in the app, not by a database foreign key

decisions.note: Individual decisions also logged as activity rows

external_message_id.note: Outlook or Teams message ID. Unique, prevents duplicate imports

is_decision.note: Flags decisions for the timeline filter

entity_type.note: One email can link to account, opportunity and project

entity_id.note: Record ID in that table. Validated in the app

exit_gate.note: Plain-language gate shown in the UI

parallel_group.note: Stages sharing a number can run together

is_blocking.note: Blocking means the stage cannot complete without it

override_reason.note: Required if a blocking requirement was bypassed
